html:
A war between the Eastern Roman and Sasanian empires from 572 to 591, fought mostly in Mesopotamia and the Caucasus.

Justin II broke the Fifty-Year Peace by stopping payments and supporting a rising of Christian Armenians against Persia. It went badly at once: in 573 the Persians took the fortress of Dara, and the shock is said to have driven Justin mad. Years of raids and sieges followed under his successors Tiberius II and Maurice, with neither side gaining much.

The war was ended by a crisis in Persia. In 590 the general Bahram Chobin rebelled and the shah Hormizd IV was overthrown. His son Khosrow II fled to the Romans. Maurice sent an army that put him back on the throne in 591, and in return Rome got Dara back and most of Armenia and Iberia. The peace was the best Rome ever got from Persia, but it lasted only until Maurice was murdered in 602, which started the last great war.
sum: A war between the Eastern Roman and Sasanian empires from 572 to 591, fought mostly in Mesopotamia and the Caucasus.
